title: Learning vs. Optimizing Players in Budgeted Games
abstract: arXiv:2611.05580v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study repeated general games over $T$ rounds between a utility-maximizing optimizer and a learning agent, where budget constraints couple the players' decisions across rounds. Without budgets, low swap regret simultaneously guarantees the learner sublinear regret and caps the optimizer at its Stackelberg value. Budgets break this picture: adversarial no-regret becomes impossible, so the natural goals are non-manipulability---no adaptive optimizer earns more than $\mathtt{BSE} \cdot T + o(T)$, where $\mathtt{BSE}$ is its Budgeted Stackelberg Equilibrium value---and low stochastic regret when the optimizer plays a fixed mixed strategy. translated_title: 预算约束博弈中的学习型玩家与优化型玩家
translated_abstract: 我们研究了持续 $T$ 轮的重复一般博弈，博弈双方分别为一个效用最大化的优化者与一个学习智能体，其中预算约束将双方在各轮中的决策耦合在一起。在没有预算的情况下，低交换遗憾可以同时保证学习者获得次线性遗憾，并将优化者的收益上限限制在其 Stackelberg 值。而预算打破了这一图景：对抗性的无悔学习变得不可能实现，因此自然的目标是两个方面：一是不可操纵性——即任何自适应的优化者都不能获得超过 $\mathtt{BSE} \cdot T + o(T)$ 的收益，其中 $\mathtt{BSE}$ 是其预算 Stackelberg 均衡值；二是当优化者采用固定混合策略时实现低随机遗憾。我们提出了一个高效的、满足预算可行性的学习算法，该算法在每个预算博弈中都能同时实现上述两个目标：任何自适应优化者（无论其是否受预算约束）的期望收益至多为 $\mathtt{BSE} \cdot T + O(\sqrt{T})$，并且当优化者在常数个区间中的每一个区间上采用固定混合策略时……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文针对预算约束下的重复博弈提出了一个高效且预算可行的学习算法，能够同时实现不可操纵性——任何自适应优化者的期望收益至多为预算 Stackelberg 均衡值乘以 $T$ 加上 $O(\sqrt{T})$——以及当优化者采用固定混合策略时的低随机遗憾。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an efficient, budget-feasible learning algorithm for budgeted repeated games that simultaneously achieves non-manipulability—any adaptive optimizer earns at most BSE·T + O(√T) in expectation—and low stochastic regret against optimizers playing fixed mixed strategies.
